اخرنطما (form IIIq)
# اِخْرَنْطَمَا (iḵranṭamā) /ix.ran.tˤa.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# اِخْرَنْطِمَا (iḵranṭimā) /ix.ran.tˤi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
